test_cases.title: Applicant finds the letter counts add up to every profile
acs: DERIVED: Applicant finds the letter counts add up to every profile - features/gap-closure/gap-closure.feature:36

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search Disease Profiles page with published, draft and scenario versions all ticked and the letter All
steps.expected: The Search Disease Profiles page is displayed with all three display options ticked

steps.action: Search with each letter A to Z and note the counts, then search with All
steps.expected: The 26 counts add up to the count for All

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

steps.action: Check the page heading
steps.expected: The page heading is visible

test_cases.title: Applicant reaches the last page of results
acs: DERIVED: Applicant reaches the last page of results - features/gap-closure/gap-closure.feature:41

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search Disease Profiles page with published, draft and scenario versions all ticked and the letter All
steps.expected: The Search Disease Profiles page is displayed with all three display options ticked

steps.action: Click the highest page number under the results
steps.expected: The last page is displayed and marked as current

steps.action: Count the profiles on the last page
steps.expected: The count equals the remainder of the total divided by the page size

steps.action: Check the page numbers under the results
steps.expected: There is a Previous page link and no Next page link

test_cases.title: Applicant sorts by recency and the newest comes before the oldest
acs: DERIVED: Applicant sorts by recency and the newest comes before the oldest - features/gap-closure/gap-closure.feature:48

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search Disease Profiles page with published, draft and scenario versions all ticked and the letter All
steps.expected: The Search Disease Profiles page is displayed with all three display options ticked

steps.action: Choose "Least recently updated" in the Sort by list
steps.expected: The results reload in that order

steps.action: Note the date shown for the first profile
steps.expected: The date is noted

steps.action: Choose "Most recently updated" in the Sort by list
steps.expected: The results reload in that order

steps.action: Compare the first profile date with the noted date
steps.expected: The newer sort shows an equal or later date

test_cases.title: Applicant uses the header menu on a phone-sized screen
acs: DERIVED: Applicant uses the header menu on a phone-sized screen - features/gap-closure/gap-closure.feature:70

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Set the browser window to 375 by 667 pixels
steps.expected: The page uses the phone layout

steps.action: Open the home page
steps.expected: The home page is displayed

steps.action: Check the header menu
steps.expected: The menu panel is hidden and the menu button is not expanded

steps.action: Open the header menu
steps.expected: The menu panel is displayed

steps.action: Check the menu panel
steps.expected: It offers Search disease profiles, General reports, Disease ranking report and View species data

steps.action: Press the Escape key
steps.expected: The menu closes

steps.action: Check the header menu
steps.expected: The menu panel is hidden and the menu button is not expanded
